# Jaswant Kanojia

> Marketing Operations & MarTech specialist based in Lucknow, India. Sole digital marketing function for a 3-brand, 22-location automotive dealership group (Royal Enfield, Bajaj three-wheelers, Tata commercial vehicles). Builds the CRM, lead-operations, and local-SEO systems that marketing runs on, not just the campaigns on top of it.

## Key facts
- Role: Marketing Operations & Digital Marketing Associate at Lucknow Diesel & Electricals (LDE Royal Enfield, LDE Bajaj) and Swift Trucks LLP (Tata Commercial Vehicles), Lucknow — since March 2026.
- Built LeadForge, a Flask/PostgreSQL CRM managing 826+ leads across three dealership brands; recovered ~600 previously unattended Meta leads and cut response time to under 30 minutes.
- Took Google Business Profile presence from 2 to 17 verified, fully optimised locations (of 22 total).
- Rebuilt 5 dealership websites with technical SEO fixes and GA4/GTM/Search Console instrumentation.
- Education: B.Sc. (Physics & Chemistry), University of Lucknow, 2020. Google Digital Marketing Professional Certificate, HubSpot Digital Marketing Certification. NIELIT ADCA/DCA/CCC.
- Contact: jaswantkanojia04@gmail.com · +91 86016 15224 · Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Live systems
- [LeadForge CRM](https://kzleadforge.up.railway.app/): Flask/PostgreSQL CRM for lead operations across three dealership brands.
- [LDE Royal Enfield](https://kzldere.pages.dev/): Motorcycle dealership site with EMI calculator and structured data.
- [LDE Bajaj](https://ldebajaj.pages.dev/): Three-wheeler dealership site.
- [Swift Trucks](https://kzswiftrucks.pages.dev/): Tata commercial-vehicle dealership site with comparison tools.
- [LDE combined](https://kzlde.pages.dev/): Landing page unifying the Royal Enfield and Bajaj brands.
